import io,json,os,subprocess,tarfile,tempfile,urllib.request,shutil
from pathlib import Path
sha='b2869e334d9d68a0c988905e71ce0badec6ba359'
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
releases=root/'releases'
dest=releases/sha
out={'action':'ferrari_new_git_release_staging','sha':sha,'active_unchanged':True}
tmp=None
try:
 assert releases.is_dir() and not releases.is_symlink() and os.access(releases,os.W_OK)
 assert (root/'tools/hopper-6.6.1/opt/hopper/bin/Hopper').is_file()
 if not dest.is_dir():
  req=urllib.request.Request('https://codeload.github.com/martaxi-boss/skill-universal/tar.gz/'+sha,headers={'User-Agent':'Ferrari-Private-Release/1'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=45) as r:
   assert r.status==200 and r.url.startswith('https://codeload.github.com/'),'GitHub source URL invalid'
   payload=r.read(60000000)
  assert 10000<len(payload)<60000000,'unexpected source length'
  tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.ferrari-staging-',dir=releases))
  with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(payload),mode='r:gz') as tar:
   names={Path(m.name).parts[0] for m in tar.getmembers() if m.name}
   assert len(names)==1,'unexpected archive roots'
   tar.extractall(tmp,filter='data')
  src=tmp/next(iter(names))
  assert src.is_dir() and (src/'engine/rea_mcp.py').is_file()
  assert (src/'install/vps-hopper-private.py').is_file() and (src/'tests/test_private_hopper_launcher.py').is_file()
 else:
  src=dest
 test=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-q'],cwd=src,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=95)
 out['unit_tests_exit']=test.returncode
 out['unit_tests_last_lines']=(test.stdout+test.stderr).splitlines()[-5:]
 assert test.returncode==0,'new release unit tests failed'
 probe=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-c',"from pathlib import Path;from engine.rea_mcp import _resources; _,e=_resources(Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal'));print(e.get('HOPPER_LAUNCHER_PATH','missing'))"],cwd=src,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
 expected=str(root/'tools/hopper-6.6.1/opt/hopper/bin/Hopper')
 assert probe.returncode==0 and probe.stdout.strip()==expected,'new REA provider not routed to private Hopper'
 out['private_hopper_routed']=True
 if tmp is not None:
  src.rename(dest)
  out['new_release_created']=True
 else:out['new_release_created']=False
 out['status']='STAGED_VERIFIED'
except Exception as e:
 out.update({'status':'FAILED','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:250]})
finally:
 if tmp is not None:shutil.rmtree(tmp,ignore_errors=True)
out['current_after']=str((root/'current').resolve(strict=False))
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
